hazards.evidence: The staircase has a handrail on only the right side; no handrail is visible along the left side.
The visible right-hand rail ends well above the lower stairs and does not provide continuous support for the full flight.
The stairway is dimly lit, with the lower stairs and landing in heavy shadow.
The carpeted stair edges have poor visual contrast, and the covering appears uneven or rumpled on several middle steps.
A cord runs across the walking area at the foot of the stairs.
